definitions.explanation: A female performer in theater, film, or television.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{女優|じょゆう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧{女優|じょゆう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}した→受賞：11867_jushou⟧。
examples.english: The lead actress won the award.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧{女優|じょゆう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I wanted to become an actress.

notes:
{女優|じょゆう} specifically refers to female actors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{主演|しゅえん}→主演：08254_shuen⟧{女優|じょゆう} (lead actress)
- ⟦{助演|じょえん}→助演：18098_joen⟧{女優|じょゆう} (supporting actress)
- {女優|じょゆう}⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧ (best actress award)
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{女優|じょゆう} (popular actress)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {女優|じょゆう}: actress (female)
- ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: actor (traditionally male, now sometimes gender-neutral)
- ⟦{男優|だんゆう}→男優：28277_danyuu⟧: male actor (less commonly used)

Note: In modern usage, ⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧ is increasingly used as a gender-neutral term for actors, similar to English.
